products.name: The Royal Executive Sectional Sofa
products.description: Plush, deep-seated sectional sofa upholstered in premium fabric with high-density cushioning designed for luxurious family gatherings and formal reception.

products.name: Aosta Modern Velvet 3-Seater
products.description: An iconic silhouette featuring elegant tufted detailing and tapered wooden legs. Built to anchor any contemporary living room with sophistication.

products.name: Dogon Karfi Center Table Set
products.description: A harmonious nested coffee table and side table combination featuring rich walnut finishes and brushed gold accents.

products.name: Jos Grand Accent Armchair
products.description: A statement armchair offering generous seating depth and wrap-around backrest support for ultimate reading or relaxation.

products.name: Plateau Imperial King Bed Frame
products.description: A majestic upholstered headboard with vertical channel tufting, creating a tranquil and luxurious focal point for your master bedroom.

products.name: Sanctuary 6-Door Wardrobe
products.description: Spacious wardrobe featuring multi-compartment shelving, hanging rails, and soft-close mirrored doors for effortless bedroom organization.

products.name: Minimalist Walnut Bedside Dresser
products.description: Sleek two-drawer bedside table designed with clean lines and smooth gliding drawers for night-time essentials.

products.name: Custom Executive Office Suite
products.description: Tailored executive desk and matching credenza designed to elevate private home studies and corporate boardrooms.

products.name: Bespoke Dining Table & Chairs
products.description: Custom-built dining set tailored to seat your family and guests comfortably, crafted with durability and unforgettable aesthetics in mind.

products.name: Console & Entryway Credenza
products.description: An elegant slimline console table designed for grand entryways, hallways, or behind living room sofas.

products.name: Lounge Ottoman & Footstool
products.description: Versatile upholstered ottoman that doubles as extra seating or a comfortable footrest.

aboutStory.heroSubtitle: Serving customers in Jos, Plateau State, Tatari Furniture is dedicated to bringing exceptional comfort, lasting quality, and distinctive style into every home.
aboutStory.storyHeading: Crafting Spaces That Inspire Comfort & Style
aboutStory.storyParagraph1: Your home is your sanctuary. At Tatari Furniture, we believe that every sofa, bed, and custom living piece should do more than simply fill a room—it should enrich your daily living experience.
aboutStory.storyParagraph2: Located at 179 Dogon Karfi, Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria, we welcome clients to explore our showroom and discover pieces selected for their visual elegance, ergonomic comfort, and enduring durability.
